currencyCopy.loading: Checking the local currency. Amounts remain in {currency} until a rate is available.
currencyCopy.unavailable: A current local exchange rate is unavailable. Amounts remain in {currency}.
currencyCopy.converted: Amounts converted from {base} to {currency} using the reference rate dated {date}.
currencyCopy.basis: Currency conversion is not local cost research. Enter your own local costs and contribution assumptions. Language changes do not change amounts.

costCopy.budgetOnly: This is your total budget. Switch to Cost breakdown to itemize it; no split has been assumed.
costCopy.benefitNotice: Modeled benefits, not charges. Crossed-out amounts are spending you expect to avoid, not discounts on the AI bill.
costCopy.allocation: Returned hours are capacity, not automatic savings. Only the portions you assign to actual spending reductions or additional contribution receive a monetary value.

copy.workloadIntro: Count time spent checking food, choosing recipes and preparing your grocery list—not cooking, travel or time in the shop.
copy.costIntro: Your estimated KAI price follows your planning sessions, with a base price for light usage and an increase for additional usage.
copy.valueIntro: Time back is yours to enjoy. Add an explicit food-waste or personal-value assumption if you want a money comparison.
copy.sampleNotice: Typical household usage · adjust these numbers to your kitchen
copy.retained: Personal time, not priced in money
copy.reviewNote: Checking portions, allergies, ingredients and the cart takes time. Household review is subtracted from time back. Help you pay for separately is an extra expense in the optional money comparison; it is not part of the KAI price.
copy.budgetNote: Include KAI access, extra services and any extra paid help once. Do not include your usual grocery bill or put a price on your own time.
copy.itemizedNote: Token usage is calculated from your plans. Extra services stay at zero unless you pay for them separately.
copy.annualNote: Twelve months using the same routine and food-waste assumptions. No growth, compounding or guaranteed savings.
copy.methodBody: Hours back equals planning sessions × minutes per session × the share KAI could reduce, minus your checking time. Personal time stays separate from money unless you explicitly enter a comparison value. Optional food value equals portions you expect to stop wasting × their ingredient cost, only where using that food replaces a future purchase.
copy.formulaLabel: Estimated net benefit subtracts your KAI price and any separately paid checking from the optional value you enter. Unpriced personal time is shown in hours only.
copy.allocationNote: All returned time remains personal time. It is never converted into wages, business revenue or cash savings.
copy.overlapLabel: These portions would otherwise be wasted, replace a future purchase, and are not also counted as a discount or another saving.
copy.overlapNote: Count only edible food you would safely use. Ingredient cost excludes your time and KAI fees. Do not count the same food as both a duplicate purchase avoided and waste prevented.
copy.hiringLabel: This hire was genuinely planned and the allocated capacity can cover the work.
copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed my assumptions. If I leave food waste unselected, only my time estimate counts as a benefit.
copy.throughputResult: Additional work supported by capacity and demand
copy.assumptionsIncomplete: You can keep this as a time estimate. Add and review optional value assumptions to compare them with your KAI price.
copy.allocationError: Allocated hours exceed the net capacity available. Reduce the allocations.
copy.reviewError: Checking takes longer than the planning time reduced. These assumptions do not return positive time.
copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
copy.riskError: The after probability cannot exceed the before probability for a loss-reduction estimate.
copy.overlapError: Confirm the food value replaces spending and is not counted twice before including it.
copy.boundsError: Use values within the displayed limits.
copy.noCurrencyChange: Language changes formatting, not your currency or assumptions.

volume.label: Grocery-planning sessions each month
volume.help: For example, four weekly plans. Count your whole household once, not once per person.

accepted_rate.label: Expected acceptance rate
accepted_rate.help: Optional modeled share of prepared outputs accepted by the recipient. This is not a guarantee or observed result.

minutes.label: Planning minutes per session today
minutes.help: Include fridge checks, recipe decisions, product comparison and list preparation. Exclude cooking and shopping travel.

automation.label: Share KAI could help reduce
automation.help: Your estimate, not a promised performance level. Start modestly and check against your actual routine.

review.label: Minutes to check each plan
review.help: Allow time to verify ingredients, portions, allergies, current prices and the final shopping list.

cycles_per_unit.label: Cycles per unit each month
cycles_per_unit.help: How many recurring order, review or processing cycles each unit runs in a typical month.

tokens_per_output.label: Tokens to build one plan
tokens_per_output.help: Modeled tokens to turn a fridge or receipt scan into a checked plan. Shown so you can see usage; you do not need a provider price.

budget.label: Your monthly KAI budget
budget.help: Your own estimate for access and extra services, not a price quote. Exclude the usual grocery bill.

model_cost.label: Additional usage
model_cost.help: The amount above the base price needed to cover your estimated usage.

tools_cost.label: Extra connected services
tools_cost.help: Only additional service charges needed for KAI, not ordinary food purchases.

infrastructure_cost.label: Extra hosting or storage
infrastructure_cost.help: Enter zero unless you pay for this separately.

platform_cost.label: Modelled service cost
platform_cost.help: Internal token, model, hosting, storage and support cost used to estimate the displayed KAI price.

customer_price.label: Base price
customer_price.help: The minimum price for the selected period. Your estimated total increases when usage exceeds the included allowance.

personal_value_per_hour.label: Optional value you assign to one hour
personal_value_per_hour.help: Use only for a personal comparison. This is not salary, wages or guaranteed savings.

review_rate.label: Extra paid checking per hour
review_rate.help: Use actual additional spending on help, never an hourly value for your own time.

cash_hours.label: Hours that remove paid work
cash_hours.help: Allocate only work whose overtime, contractor or processing spend will actually stop.

cash_baseline.label: Current monthly spending on that work
cash_baseline.help: The cash budget from which the reduction will come.

cash_avoided.label: Monthly spending you would stop
cash_avoided.help: One explicit amount, not hours multiplied by salary; exclude any planned-hire saving entered separately.

higher_value_hours.label: Hours used for higher-value work
higher_value_hours.help: Hours you can realistically redirect, not the entire capacity by default.

contribution_rate.label: Incremental contribution per hour
contribution_rate.help: Revenue less incremental delivery costs, excluding AI costs counted separately. Not salary or gross revenue.

throughput_hours.label: Hours used for additional volume
throughput_hours.help: This allocation cannot also be used for advisory work or spending reductions.

extra_minutes.label: Team minutes per additional unit
extra_minutes.help: The remaining human effort, including review, needed to deliver one more unit.

demand.label: Additional units with expected demand
demand.help: Capacity alone is not demand. Enter the extra monthly work you expect to take on.

unit_margin.label: Contribution per additional unit
unit_margin.help: Incremental revenue less delivery costs; AI operating costs are deducted separately.

hiring_hours.label: Hours covering the planned hire
hiring_hours.help: Allocate capacity to specific planned work, not a generic full-time-equivalent estimate.

planned_hours.label: Monthly hours the planned hire would cover
planned_hours.help: The allocated capacity must cover this entire workload.

hire_cost.label: Monthly hire cost actually deferred
hire_cost.help: Use the cost of a genuinely planned hire, not the salary of someone already employed.

hire_months.label: Months that hire is deferred
hire_months.help: One to twelve months; the annual estimate stops counting savings after this period.

incidents.label: Food portions you could stop wasting each month
incidents.help: Enter a realistic reduction from what you currently throw away. Count only food you would safely use instead of buying a replacement.

incident_cost.label: Ingredient cost per avoided wasted portion
incident_cost.help: Use the average cost of the ingredients, not a restaurant price or the value of your cooking time.

probability_before.label: Monthly loss probability before
probability_before.help: Your estimate, not a guaranteed risk assessment.

probability_after.label: Monthly loss probability after
probability_after.help: Use the same event and monthly time horizon as the baseline.

loss.label: Loss exposure for that event
loss.help: Exclude error incidents and spending already counted. This is uncertain expected value, not cash saved.

days_before.label: Cycle time before, in days
days_before.help: Elapsed time from start to completion, separate from hands-on effort.

days_after.label: Cycle time after, in days
days_after.help: Shown as an operational change only, without an assumed monetary value.

copy.brand.ariaLabel: KAI Retail: Inventory and Vendor Ordering
copy.brand.subtitle: Inventory & Vendor Ordering
copy.hero.eyebrow: KAI RETAIL · STOCK ACCURACY & VENDOR ORDERS
copy.hero.heading: Turn stock photos, counts and invoices into vendor-ready orders.
copy.hero.body: For multi-location grocery and specialty operators who still rely on spreadsheets and floor time. Your named approver reviews every suggested order.
copy.stage.captureHint: Tap to run the sample stock check
copy.stage.lastReconciled: Last physical count reconciled with the live list
copy.stage.billingNote: You keep direct vendor billing. KAI prepares the quantities and order format.
copy.pain.heading: Three lines an owner or operations lead knows too well.
copy.media.inventoryCountAlt: A grocery operations lead carrying out a physical stock count in a store room
copy.pain.mediaCaption: Start with a physical count your team can trust.
copy.media.painStockSpreadsheetAlt: An operations lead checking shelf stock against a laptop spreadsheet in a grocery stockroom
copy.pain.card1.heading: Stock counted in a spreadsheet that’s already wrong.
copy.pain.card1.body: The count was accurate when someone typed it. Sales, damaged stock, and new deliveries changed it immediately.
copy.media.painVendorLateAlt: A grocery buyer checking a phone beside fresh produce while facing a late replenishment gap
copy.pain.card2.heading: Vendor orders placed too late.
copy.pain.card2.body: The shelf gap is visible only after the order cut-off passes, turning a normal replenishment into an emergency.
copy.media.painMultiShopAlt: A multi-store buyer juggling phone calls, invoices, and a laptop at a grocery counter
copy.pain.card3.heading: One person covering several shops.
copy.pain.card3.body: The same buyer is checking messages, invoices, pack sizes, and stock notes across locations without one current view.
copy.loop.heading: Capture what is there. Order what is about to be missing.
copy.loop.body: A practical loop for the people already responsible for the shelf, not another system to maintain.
copy.loop.step1.heading: Capture stock from photos, invoices, or a simple list.
copy.loop.step1.body: A back-room photo, supplier invoice, or quick count is enough to update the working inventory.
copy.loop.step2.heading: KAI tracks on-hand, incoming, and likely run-out.
copy.loop.step2.body: Each SKU stays tied to current stock, incoming deliveries, and its recent pace of movement.
copy.loop.step3.heading: You approve a vendor order.
copy.loop.step3.body: KAI drafts the quantities against pack sizes and vendor minimums. One named approver decides what is placed.
copy.loop.step4.heading: You keep your vendors.
copy.loop.step4.body: KAI does not replace your ERP on day one. It starts as the operational layer between the physical count and the order.
copy.pilot.heading: Prove the stock loop in one place before you widen it.
copy.pilot.body: Choose one location or one category. Your staff uses KAI in the real operating rhythm, and one named approver reviews each suggested order.
copy.media.vendorOrderAlt: An independent grocery buyer reviewing a vendor order beside incoming produce
copy.pilot.guaranteeHeading: Inventory matches a physical count within an agreed error band, or the week is free.
copy.pilot.bullet4: Your existing vendors stay in place
copy.pilot.boundaryBody: We do not guarantee sell-through or supplier prices. The pilot measures stock accuracy and the cleanliness of vendor orders.
copy.scope.heading: Who KAI Retail is not for.
copy.media.vendorDeliveryAlt: Retail staff receiving grocery stock from an existing delivery partner
copy.scope.mediaCaption: Your vendors stay in place. KAI makes the handoff cleaner.
copy.media.homeCookAlt: A home cook preparing dinner in a domestic kitchen
copy.scope.card1.heading: Home cooks
copy.scope.card1.body: KAI Retail is for stores, wholesale teams, and the people responsible for stock.
copy.media.mealPlanningAlt: A person planning household meals at a kitchen table
copy.scope.card2.heading: Meal planning
copy.scope.card2.body: No recipes, cooking plans, or consumer meal suggestions appear in the retail workspace.
copy.media.consumerDeliveryAlt: A grocery courier delivering bags to a customer at home
copy.scope.card3.heading: Consumer grocery delivery
copy.scope.card3.body: This page is about replenishing shops and downstream retailers through existing vendors.
copy.form.heading: Start with the operation you most want to make reliable.
copy.form.body: Tell us where stock accuracy is hardest today. We will reply with a short slot to confirm the location, category, error band, and approver.
copy.footer.tagline: Stock accuracy, run-out visibility, and cleaner vendor orders for retail and wholesale teams.
copy.footer.privacyNote: Pilot details are used only to review and respond to your request.
copy.form.error: The request did not go through. Please try again.
copy.form.note: Paid four-week pilot · scope and error band agreed before work starts

copy.workloadIntro: Model vendor-ready order preparation for independent multi-store operators—not household meal planning and not a shrink guarantee.
copy.costIntro: Tokens and delivery cost describe what it costs KAI to provide the service. Customer price and customer value are separate assumptions.
copy.valueIntro: Review gross preparation time, human review time and net floor capacity. Add a value assumption only when you can support it.
copy.reviewNote: Existing-team review uses returned capacity. Additional paid review is included in operating cost, not deducted again from team capacity.
copy.budgetNote: The budget must include models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review. Do not include unchanged payroll as new spending.

copy.annualNote: The same monthly assumptions, without growth or compounding. Hiring savings last only for the entered period.
copy.methodBody: Preparation time equals stores × replenishment cycles × preparation minutes × the KAI-handled share. Review time is stores × cycles × review minutes. Net capacity subtracts review only when the existing team handles it. A named approver remains required.
copy.formulaLabel: Customer ROI = (modeled customer benefit − customer price) ÷ customer price. Capacity is not automatic payroll savings.
copy.allocationNote: Each hour can be allocated once. Unallocated hours remain capacity, with no monetary value.
copy.overlapLabel: These benefits are distinct; I have excluded costs and losses already counted elsewhere.
copy.overlapNote: Error and risk estimates exclude labor savings and the same incident must not appear in both categories. Contribution excludes AI costs, which are deducted separately.

copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed my outcomes; unselected outcomes have no financial value in this estimate.

copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
